## berth org exec

run a command in the container as node (for tools)

### Synopsis

run a command in the container as node (for tools)

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_org_exec/

```
berth org exec <org> [--cwd DIR] [--env K=V]... -- <command> [args...] [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  berth org exec acme -- git -C app status
  berth org exec acme --cwd app --env CI=1 -- make test
```
